value.signature: fn deserialize < D : Deserializer < 'de > > (deserializer : D) -> Result < Self , D :: Error >

exception.justification: Justified: a source kind is one of the closed string names, never an enum-shaped object.

review.body: { let value = String :: deserialize (deserializer) ? ; match value . as_str () { "registry" => Ok (Self :: Registry) , "git" => Ok (Self :: Git) , "path" => Ok (Self :: Path) , "patch" => Ok (Self :: Patch) , "notice" => Ok (Self :: Notice) , "compiler" => Ok (Self :: Compiler) , "component" => Ok (Self :: Component) , "selection" => Ok (Self :: Selection) , _ => Err (serde :: de :: Error :: unknown_variant (& value , & ["registry" , "git" , "path" , "patch" , "notice" , "compiler" , "component" , "selection" ,] ,)) , } }
review.item_premise: This body handles public installation evidence and conditional outcomes; it records no private installation observation or claimed trust.
